title: Oil Suffers Worst Run This Year as Hormuz Deal Reshapes Outlook
title_zh: 霍尔木兹协议重塑前景，油价今年遭遇最糟糕表现
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Oil headed for its longest losing streak this year as the US-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz boosted expectations for a revival in supply, with leading Wall Street banks reducing their price forecasts.Most Read from BloombergIran’s Deputy Foreign Minist...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——由于美伊重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议提振了供应复苏的预期，导致华尔街主要银行降低了价格预测，油价今年将迎来最长的连续下跌。

title: Salesforce’s Fin Deal Aims To Expand Agentforce AI And Investor Upside
title_zh: Salesforce 的 Fin 交易旨在扩大 Agentforce AI 和投资者的优势
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) agreed to acquire AI customer service platform Fin for US$3.6b. The deal is intended to fold Fin into Salesforce's Agentforce offering to expand autonomous digital labor capabilities.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）同意以 3.6 亿美元收购人工智能客户服务平台 Fin。该交易旨在将 Fin 纳入 Salesforce 的 Agentforce 产品，以扩展自主数字劳动力能力。

title: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) Soars 13% as US-Iran Peace Deal Propels AI Stocks
title_zh: 美伊和平协议推动人工智能股上涨，应用光电公司 (AAOI) 飙升 13%
summary: Applied Optoelectronics Inc. (NASDAQ:AAOI) is one of the 10 Stocks Stealing the Spotlight from Wall Street Giants.
summary_zh: 应用光电公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAOI）是吸引华尔街巨头关注的 10 只股票之一。

title: APA Corporation Acquires Savant Alaska in $70 Million Deal
title_zh: APA 公司以 7000 万美元收购 Savant Alaska
summary: APA Corporation (NASDAQ:APA) is included among the 14 Best S&P 500 Stocks to Buy Now According to Analysts. APA Corporation (NASDAQ:APA) is an independent energy company that explores for, develops, and produces natural gas, crude oil, and natural gas liquids.
summary_zh: 据分析师称，APA Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：APA）被列入目前最值得购买的 14 只标准普尔 500 指数股票之一。 APA Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：APA）是一家独立能源公司，致力于勘探、开发和生产天然气、原油和液化天然气。

title: Exxon Mobil Mulling Acquisition of Australia’s Woodside Energy, Bloomberg Reports

summary: Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) is included among the 14 Best S&P 500 Stocks to Buy Now According to Analysts. Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) is one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants, and chemical companies in the world.
